title: Parse kind-segmented addresses into scope, kind, and self-id components
description:
jit's current qualified-id parser, `split_qualified_id` (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:678-680`), only splits a value on the first `/` into a `(scope, self-id)` pair — there is no kind segment and no notion of a named-project scope token. This task adds a new, pure domain-layer parser (alongside `Scope` in `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs`, following the existing `Scope::parse`/`prefix` pattern at lines 89-152) that recognizes the three address forms this work requires, splitting each into its `(scope, kind, self-id)` components:

- `@/<kind>/<self-id>` — the local-project form (bare `@`, `Scope::Project`).
- `@<name>/<kind>/<self-id>` — a named-project form. Parse `<name>` into a new scope variant (e.g. extend the `Scope` enum with a `NamedProject(String)` case) purely STRUCTURALLY: this task only recognizes and carries the name token, it does not attempt to resolve it against any declared project identity (that resolution is separate work, outside this item).
- `@/issue/<short-id>/<kind>/<self-id>` — the issue-item form, where `issue` is a reserved literal segment (not a kind name), yielding `Scope::Issue(short_id)`.

This is additive: it does not remove or modify `split_qualified_id` or any of its four existing call sites (`commands/item.rs:292`, `commands/item.rs:402`, `commands/validate.rs:317`, `validation/graph.rs:90`) — those are migrated in a later change. A malformed address (missing kind segment, missing self-id, an unrecognized reserved segment where `issue` is expected, or extra/too-few `/`-separated segments) returns a clear typed error rather than `None`/a panic — extend `ItemError` (`domain/item.rs:245-355`) with a variant naming the offending input and why it failed to parse.

The colon `:` is not treated as a parser separator anywhere in this new code — it stays exclusively the label `namespace:value` delimiter; that is unaffected by this domain-layer change.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: a new pure parsing function/type in `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs` parses `@/<kind>/<self-id>` into `(Scope::Project, kind, self_id)`, `@<name>/<kind>/<self-id>` into a named-project scope token carrying `<name>` plus `(kind, self_id)` (no resolution against any declared name), and `@/issue/<short-id>/<kind>/<self-id>` into `(Scope::Issue(short_id), kind, self_id)`; unit tests cover all three forms round-tripping into their component parts.
- [hard] REQ-02: malformed input (no kind segment, no self-id segment, wrong reserved segment in place of `issue`, empty scope/kind/self-id segments) returns a typed `ItemError` variant identifying the bad input, verified by unit tests for at least: missing-kind, missing-self-id, and bad-reserved-segment cases.
- [hard] REQ-03: `split_qualified_id` (`domain/item.rs:678-680`) and its four existing call sites (`commands/item.rs:292,402`, `commands/validate.rs:317`, `validation/graph.rs:90`) are left unmodified and their existing tests continue to pass unchanged — this task only adds the new parser, it does not wire any caller to it.
